Case A (PINNED): agent_filesystem source whose discovery_agent_id resolves to a real online agent is Healthy with exactly one required dependency
Case A (PINNED, offline): the pinned agent is real but offline -> Unavailable/agent_offline, not open-claim fallback
Case A (PINNED, retired): the pinned agent has been retired -> permanent Unavailable/assigned_agent_retired, never falls through to open-claim
Case B (OPEN-CLAIM, single agent online): a non-agent_filesystem certificate with one matching declared selector is Healthy
Case B (OPEN-CLAIM, redundant, all online): two agents declaring the same selector -> Healthy, neither individually required
Case B->Degraded (OPEN-CLAIM, redundant, partial outage): one of two declaring agents offline -> Degraded/partial_location_outage
Case C (OPEN-CLAIM, all executors down): both declaring agents offline -> Unavailable/all_executors_offline
